title: A title on the Press — content/books/ and content/adjacent/
description: One file per title. The NN- filename prefix fixes shelf order.

id.description: The permalink: lowercase words joined by hyphens. Renaming it breaks every `across` link pointing here and any URL a reader saved. Change it only on purpose, and fix the referrers in the same edit.

keep.description: The one line a reader leaves with, drawn from this entry's own argument — not a general maxim. One sentence that makes sense read alone.

title.description: The title as printed on the cover and in the reader.

sub.description: The subtitle — what this is actually about. Printed under the title.

field.description: The shelf section. Titles in use: Technology, History, Economics, Philosophy. The adjacent shelf uses Adjacent.

spineTitle.description: The title as printed on the spine. Usually the same as `title`; shorten it if the full title will not fit.

years.description: The period covered, shown as 'Period' in the reader. Text, not a number: "1829–1919", "Ongoing".

cover.description: Livery: the cover colour, #RRGGBB. `npm run new` picks an unused set of four.

spineC.description: Livery: the spine colour — a shade darker than `cover`.

ink.description: Livery: the lettering colour on the cover. Light, so it reads against `cover`.

accent.description: Livery: the accent colour — the motif and the small details.

claim.description: The argument in one sentence, printed large at the top of the reader. The house median is eight words.

lede.description: The opening hook, read straight after the claim.

copy.description: The entry itself, one string per paragraph. Nearly impersonal, mechanism first. Keep each paragraph on one line — the editor wraps it for you.

d.description: Who they are to this story, in one line.

facts.description: The numbers, each with its named source. A number with no source does not ship.

b.description: The figure as printed, big: "~2,000 yrs", "1902", "40%".

s.description: The named source for that figure — where you actually looked. House rule: required.

contested.description: Where this is still argued, and by whom — the objection at full strength, named and attributed. Never "some disagree".

changed.description: First person: what changed your mind, or what would. Printed as 'What I changed my mind about'. The most personal prose on the site.

reading.description: Where to go next. Every title on the main shelf needs at least one.

a.description: Author, with the year if useful: "Henri Poincaré, 1902".

u.description: A working link, https. http only with a reason recorded in content/http-allowlist.json.

why.description: Why this one, in a sentence.

motif.description: The pattern pressed into the cover. Anything unrecognised prints as conic.

across.description: Links to other entries. Two good links beat five weak ones. Add the link back on the other entry.

to.description: Where it points: press:<id>, lives:<id>, atlas:<principle-id> — or a wing on its own, e.g. atlas. The check fails if it points nowhere.

label.description: The name of the thing linked to, as shown.

txt.description: A fragment continuing the label, opening with an em dash: "— the other entry on where convention ends".
